title: 第二十七章 发疯的王家众人第二更第二十八章 愤怒的墨老第三更
lines: “好了，今天的课就上到这里，大家先回去领悟一下课堂内容，有什么不明白的，可以单独过来询问！”
张悬摆摆手。
“是！”五位学生应了一声退了出去。
虽然上课时间不长，还有人过来捣乱，但对他们来说，受益匪浅，可以预言，只要坚持领悟下去，肯定能修为大进！
五人各怀兴奋，刚走出房间，王涛就一把拉住妹妹王颖。
“走，跟我回家族！”
“回家族？哥哥，为什么要回去……”王颖吓了一跳。
“哼，不听哥哥的话，居然认学院最差的教师为师，我已经把这件事跟爹爹说了，他要亲自和你说说！”王涛哼道。
第一次进入课堂被扔出来，第二次进去又是无功而返，看妹妹的样子，他知道肯定劝不住了，直接让刘老回去通知家族。
打算让他爹爹，进行劝阻。
妹妹性格单纯，但对父亲的话，还是十分信服的。
“爹爹……”王颖吓得脸色一变。
他们二人的爹爹正是王家的当代家主，王弘！
一向不苟言笑，为人刻板，就算他们是儿女，每次见到都会害怕。
“张悬老师，其实不是你们说的那样，他讲课很好的……”
王颖想要反驳。
“哼，这些话你和爹爹说吧，看他相不相信！”王涛一摆手，不再说话，带着妹妹就向校外走去。
洪天学院和王家同在天玄城，距离不算太远，时间不长，兄妹二人就走回家族，王涛带着王颖来到父亲的书房。
“进来！”
王弘族长冷厉的声音响起。
“是！”王颖吓得娇躯哆嗦，一咬牙，紧跟在哥哥身后走了进去。
书房里，王弘族长正坐在正中间，两边坐着几位，都是族内有权势的长老，还有一个少年，站在一侧。
这个少年，王颖认识，二长老之孙，王岩。
她和这个王岩同时去了洪天学院，后者拜了最有名的陆寻为师，而自己却拜了学院名气最差的张悬……
“爹爹！”看到书房内，有些凝固的气息，王颖大气都不敢出。
“跪下！”
王弘族长脸色一沉。
武者修炼，启蒙恩师很重要，进入学院前，他曾三番五次交代，要拜陆寻为师，拜陆寻为师，这丫头倒好……
你拜谁不好？
非要拜这个全学院倒数第一的家伙？
刚才听到这个消息的时候，他差点没活活气死。
噗通！
王颖一哆嗦，跪了下来。
“你可知错？”王弘冷哼。
content_en:
"Okay, that's it for today's class. Let's go back and understand the class content first. If you don't understand anything, you can come and ask alone!"
Zhang Xuan waved his hand.
"Yes!" The five students responded and retreated.
Although the class was not long and there were still people who came to make trouble, it was a great benefit for them. It can be predicted that as long as they persist in understanding, they will definitely make great progress in cultivation!
The five of them were all excited. As soon as they walked out of the room, Wang Tao grabbed his sister Wang Ying.
"Let's go back to the family with me!"
"Go back to the family? Brother, why do you want to go back..." Wang Ying was startled.
"Hmph, you didn't listen to my brother and actually accepted the worst teacher in the college as your teacher. I have already told dad about this and he wants to talk to you personally!" Wang Tao snorted.
The first time he entered the class, he was thrown out, and the second time he entered the class, he returned without success. Looking at his sister's look, he knew that he would not be able to persuade her anymore, so he directly asked Mr. Liu to go back and inform the family.
He planned to ask his father to dissuade him.
My sister has a simple personality, but she is still very convinced of her father's words.
"Dad..." Wang Ying's face changed with fright.
Their father is the contemporary head of the Wang family, Wang Hong!
They have always been serious and rigid, and even if they are children, they will be scared every time they see them.
"Teacher Zhang Xuan, he is actually not who you say he is. He teaches very well..."
Wang Ying wanted to refute.
"Hmph, tell your father these words and see if he believes it!" Wang Tao waved his hand, stopped talking, and walked out of the school with his sister.
Hongtian Academy and the Wang family were in the same Tianxuan City. The distance was not too far. It didn't take long. The brother and sister walked back to the family. Wang Tao took Wang Ying to his father's study.
"Come in!"
Patriarch Wang Hong's cold and stern voice sounded.
"Yes!" Wang Ying was so frightened that her delicate body trembled. She gritted her teeth and followed her brother in.
In the study, Clan Chief Wang Hong was sitting in the middle, with several powerful elders sitting on both sides, and a young man standing on one side.
Wang Ying knew this young man, Wang Yan, the grandson of the second elder.
She and this Wang Yan went to Hongtian Academy at the same time. The latter became a disciple of the most famous Lu Xun, but she became an apprentice of Zhang Xuan, the least famous person in the academy...
"Dad!" Seeing the somewhat solid atmosphere in the study, Wang Ying didn't dare to express her anger.
"Kneel down!"
Patriarch Wang Hong’s face darkened.
When cultivating a warrior, it is very important to have an enlightenment teacher. Before entering the academy, he had repeatedly told him that he wanted to worship Lu Xun as his teacher. This girl would be a good...
Who do you want to worship?
Do you have to worship this guy who is the last in the entire academy?
When he heard the news just now, he almost died of anger.
Plop!
Wang Ying shivered and knelt down.
"Do you know you were wrong?" Wang Hong snorted coldly.
"I……"
